How Northwind Tools was founded

Northwind Tools is a manufacturer of calibrated torque wrenches based in Pune, founded in 2011 by two service engineers who were tired of sending workshop tools abroad for recalibration. The company began as a calibration bench in a rented unit and now runs a small production line alongside the original calibration service.

How the company is organised

Twenty-two people work at Northwind Tools. Nine of them are in production, six in the calibration laboratory, four in customer support and three in administration. The calibration laboratory keeps its reference transducers under an annual traceable calibration contract, and the certificates are published on request to any customer who asks for the reference chain behind their own certificate.

Where we operate

We ship across India and support workshops directly by telephone during working hours from Monday to Saturday. Larger service networks are handled by a named account engineer who visits each site once a year to sample tools for drift.
